items.html: No retention / auto-purge — TTL, max-count, scheduled GC, a scheduled / automatic retention reconciler; purge is operator-initiated here (v1 has none either). The delete-chain purge re-drive (re-running a deferred / interrupted hard_purge to completion) is already part of the LC4 baseline — what is absent is a policy engine that decides when to purge unprompted → L9 / ops
No archive query / list CLI — the index tombstones purged/archived runs, but listing / inspecting / searching them is ops tooling → ops
No restore / re-hydration — an archive is forensic, write-only; bringing a run back as a live instance is not a goal (eval-replay from the durable record is a separate concern) → later
No shared / dedup evidence ownership realized — the closure rule is open to a multi-owner T3 blob store, but the MVP is run-owned evidence → later (blob store)
No export formats / sharing — cold_copy is abstract; concrete bundle formats, redaction, and sharing are ops → ops
No cross-run / federation purge — purging across a central store or other installations is governance → L11+
